admin.draw.title: Draw
admin.draw.heading: The draw
admin.draw.tabs.label: Draw sections
admin.draw.error.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
admin.draw.error.internal: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.
admin.draw.error.conflict: This action is not possible in the current state of the draw.
admin.draw.error.invalid: The request is invalid. Check the fields and try again.
admin.draw.error.confirm: Please confirm the action before going on.
admin.draw.error.choose_pending: Choose "ignore" or "delete" for the pending sign-ups before starting the draw.
admin.draw.error.pending: Some pending sign-ups have not been handled: ignore or delete them before starting the draw.
admin.draw.error.infeasible: The draw is impossible with the current roles and cap: see the explanation and suggestions below.
admin.draw.error.date_invalid: Invalid date: it must be in the future, and it cannot be removed once the draw is done.
admin.draw.error.date_locked: The reveal is already open: the date can no longer be changed.
admin.draw.error.not_done: The draw has not been done yet.
admin.draw.notice.done: The draw is done. The pairs stay secret.
admin.draw.notice.redone: The full draw was redone. The pairs stay secret.
admin.draw.notice.opened: The reveal is now open for everyone.
admin.draw.notice.date_saved: The reveal date has been saved.
admin.draw.adjust.title: Adjust the draw
admin.draw.adjust.intro: The draw already exists. An adjustment only repairs the affected spot: the other pairs do not move. No pair is ever shown.
admin.draw.adjust.not_done: There is no draw to adjust yet: start the draw in the Draw tab first.
admin.draw.history.title: History by year
admin.draw.history.private: The history keeps the count and the date, never the pairs in view.
admin.draw.state.title: Status
admin.draw.state.secret: The pairs stay secret: nobody sees them, not even you.
admin.draw.state.not_yet: The draw has not been started yet.
admin.draw.date.locked: Reveal planned on {date}. The date can no longer be changed.
admin.draw.date.locked_open: The reveal is open: the date can no longer be changed.
admin.draw.date.label: Reveal date
admin.draw.date.help: Before this date, everyone sees a countdown. At the set time, the "draw ready" mail goes out by itself.
admin.draw.report.title: Check report
admin.draw.report.spread: Spread: {one} give one gift, {two} give two, {more} give more.
admin.draw.report.counts: {receivers} people receive a gift; cap of {cap} gifts per person.
admin.draw.report.no_names: The report never names a pair.
admin.draw.capacity.title: Capacity not enough
admin.draw.capacity.explain.too_many_one: {n} more person ready to give more than one gift is needed to spread all the gifts.
{n} more people ready to give more than one gift are needed to spread all the gifts.
The cap is too low: {n} possible gift is missing so that everyone gets theirs.
The cap is too low: {n} possible gifts are missing so that everyone gets theirs.
admin.draw.capacity.explain.too_few_give: There are not enough people who can give.
admin.draw.capacity.explain.generic: The current roles, exclusions and cap do not allow a draw.
admin.draw.capacity.propose.too_many_one: Suggestions: ask someone to switch to "Gives more", or raise the gift cap (confirmation above 2).
admin.draw.capacity.propose.cap_too_low: Suggestions: raise the gift cap (confirmation above 2), or change some roles.
admin.draw.capacity.propose.too_few_give: Suggestions: move people out of receive-only to another role, or add participants.
admin.draw.capacity.propose.generic: Suggestions: relax some exclusions or forced pairs, change roles or raise the cap.
admin.draw.roles.title: Roles in the draw
admin.draw.roles.summary: {receivers} people receive, {extra} extra gifts to give.
admin.draw.roles.offre_plus_capacity: Capacity of people ready to give more
admin.draw.roles.help: One role per person; this summary never says who gives to whom.
admin.draw.actions.title: Actions
admin.draw.open.question: Open the draw now?
admin.draw.open.body.one: {n} participant will get the "draw ready" mail right away. The planned date will be cancelled. You still will not see any pair.
admin.draw.open.body.other: {n} participants will get the "draw ready" mail right away. The planned date will be cancelled. You still will not see any pair.
admin.draw.launch.blocked: Starting is blocked while the capacity is not enough.
admin.draw.launch.question: Start the draw?
admin.draw.launch.body: The pairs are drawn once and for all and stay secret: you will not see them.
admin.draw.launch.redo_body: All the pairs will be replaced. Those who already found their target will see it change. To add or remove a person, use "Adjust the draw" instead.
admin.draw.launch.cap_confirm: I confirm the cap of {cap} gifts per person.
admin.draw.pending.help: Choose what happens to these sign-ups before starting the draw.
admin.draw.pending.ignore: Ignore: they stay pending, outside the draw
admin.draw.pending.notice.one: {n} sign-up by link is pending: a choice will be asked at launch.
admin.draw.pending.notice.other: {n} sign-ups by link are pending: a choice will be asked at launch.
